archival_memory.user_research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It's given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor noticed my ability to bridge technical coding with user experience and suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. I was hesitant at first, but it turned out to be a great decision.
